en.headline: Victoria Park lanterns stay lit through Mid-Autumn weekend
en.dek: The LCSD carnival and a first Tourism Board international display run nightly until 27 September, with lighting extended to midnight on Friday.
body: Victoria Park's Mid-Autumn lantern displays remain open through the coming festival nights, with the Leisure and Cultural Services Department advising visitors to come before Friday if they want to avoid the busiest crowds.

The Mid-Autumn Lantern Carnival occupies soccer pitches 1 to 6 from 17 to 27 September. Lanterns are lit from 6.30pm to 11pm, extending to midnight on 25 September, the festival night. Admission is free and first come, first served; the Community Programmes Office said temporary crowd controls will be used if the park fills.

This year's set is built around Hong Kong food and daily life, including lanterns shaped as egg waffles, milk tea, curry fish balls, egg tarts, wonton noodles and dim sum. The Hong Kong Tourism Board is staging its first International Lantern Spectacular in the same park, featuring the large banyan-tree lantern Shadowlight from Nanjing's Qinhuai tradition and displays associated with 20 places.

A creative night market runs from 19 to 27 September in the same hours. The Tai Hang Fire Dragon Dance is due to enter the park on festival night after 10.30pm. Naked-flame lanterns, alcohol, aerosol sprays, metallic balloons and glass bottles are barred. A separate lighting installation continues at the Hong Kong Cultural Centre Piazza until 11 October.

zh.headline: 維園綵燈會亮燈至中秋周末 正日延長至午夜
zh.dek: 康文署綵燈會及旅發局首次國際綵燈匯每日傍晚6時半至11時開放，9月25日延長至午夜12時，免費入場。
body: 維多利亞公園中秋綵燈會正值節日前數晚，康樂及文化事務署呼籲想看燈的市民盡量選擇中秋正日以外日子前往，以免人流過密。
丙午年中秋綵燈會由9月17日至27日在維園1至6號足球場舉行，亮燈時間為每晚6時30分至11時，中秋正日9月25日延長至午夜12時。社區節目辦事處指入場免費、先到先得，人多時會實施臨時人流管制，參觀者須聽從現場職員及警方指示。
今年主題圍繞香港飲食與日常，大型綵燈包括雞蛋仔、港式奶茶、咖哩魚蛋、蛋擅、雲吞麵及點心造型。香港旅遊發展局同期首次在維園舉辦「國際中秋綵燈匯」，展出南京秦淮大型榕樹綵燈《樹影流光》，並有來自約20個地方的綵燈元素。
中秋創意市集由9月19日至27日同期開放。大坑舞火龍預計中秋夜10時30分後進入維園。場內禁止明火燈籠、酒精類飲品、罐裝噴劑、金屬氣球及玻璃瓶。香港文化中心露天廣場另有光影裝置，展期至10月11日。
